name: Exterior Siding Scrape, Sand & Degloss
intent: Scrape (condition-driven at 80 SF/hr baseline), feather-sand (failing/peeling), degloss (sound paint), dust cleanup.
doctrine: Scraping at 80 SF/hr baseline — condition modifier handles severity (GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x). Feather-sand only fires for failing/peeling states. Sand weathered fires for exposed wood. Degloss fires for sound paint only. All rates at QT3 baseline.
